lines.text: Paul sends Tychicus and Onesimus to tell the Colossians all the news and to encourage their hearts.
Aristarchus, Paul's fellow prisoner, sends greetings, as does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas, whom the Colossians should welcome.
Jesus, who is called Justus, also sends greetings, and Paul says these three are the only Gentiles among his fellow workers.

wrong_details.wrong: the only Gentiles among his fellow workers
wrong_details.true: the only Jews among his fellow workers

lines.text: Epaphras wrestles in prayer for the Colossians and works hard for Laodicea and Hierapolis, and Luke the physician and Demas send greetings.
Paul tells the Colossians to greet Nympha's church, have the letter read in Laodicea, and tell Archippus to rest from his ministry.

wrong_details.wrong: tell Archippus to rest from his ministry
wrong_details.true: tell Archippus to complete the ministry he received in the Lord
